results.reason: Issue 2 calculates the § 3.2 deadline as August 16, 2026 and notes it passed before signing, with Schedule 3.12 showing the notice was not yet delivered. It says the agreement expires November 14, 2026, before the November 30 target closing. Issue 3 explains that the § 3.12(c) 'through November 2029' rep is therefore inaccurate and exposes the Sellers to indemnification claims.

Issue 1 identifies the 100% sale as a Change of Control requiring Velloran's prior written consent under § 14.2, with a termination right under § 14.3. It notes the consent is omitted from Schedule 3.6 and so is not a § 7.1(d) closing condition. It recommends adding the consent and obtaining it before closing.

Issue 4 identifies that Side Letter § 1.1 adds New York and Virginia, that this definition controls under § 19.4, and that the non-compete covers six states including the post-term period. It recommends narrowing the definition to conform to the four-state Territory.

Issue 5 identifies New York law and New York County forum in the Side Letter against Delaware law and a Wilmington forum under §§ 18.1–18.2. It explains the risk of litigating related claims in two forums under two bodies of law, and recommends conforming the Side Letter to Delaware.

States the Distribution Agreement Territory is Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania (4 states).
